webSearch.apiKey.label: Ark Harness search API key
webSearch.apiKey.help: Volcengine Ark Harness search API key (from Agent Plan → 配置 Harness → 联网 API Key). Falls back to ARK_SEARCH_API_KEY / ASK_ECHO_SEARCH_INFINITY_API_KEY env vars.

webSearch.baseUrl.label: Search Base URL
webSearch.baseUrl.help: Optional. Defaults to https://open.feedcoopapi.com (set ARK_SEARCH_BASE_URL to override).

vision.apiKey.label: Volcengine Ark API key
vision.apiKey.help: Volcengine Ark API key for chat/vision (Agent Plan). Falls back to ARK_API_KEY env var.

vision.baseUrl.label: Ark Base URL (vision)
vision.baseUrl.help: Optional. Defaults to https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3 (set ARK_BASE_URL to override).

vision.model.label: Vision Model
vision.model.help: Optional. Model used for image understanding. Defaults to doubao-seed-2.0-pro.
